geometry_edits: Replaced the original 8-vertex, 8-face, 16 m-high massing block with structural walls extruded from the official Purdue FID 918 four-corner outline.
Shifted plan position to official Purdue GIS coordinates; no scale/rotation override applied.
Built a single-story masonry-veneer shell, aluminum-framed windows and entry, pale trim, MRI corner signage, flat roof/parapet, and aerial-supported rooftop HVAC units.
Kept one mesh object in the existing collection, asset path, campus coordinate frame, and identity object transform.
uncertainties: Purdue GIS is not a survey; its positional accuracy is unpublished. OSM name/shape centroid is 1.70 m from the official Purdue footprint.
No measured facade elevations or building height are available; 4.5 m wall height and 5.85 m top of rooftop equipment are estimates.
Exact window rhythm, entry bearing, parapet dimensions, roof pitch, and MRI signage position are not verified by a compass-tagged exterior photograph.
The Purdue HHS exterior-photo URL appears in its location page but was inaccessible to direct retrieval; contractor case information is qualitative and does not replace an exterior elevation.
